title: OpenRT: An Open-Source Red Teaming Framework for Multimodal LLMs
reasoning: The paper introduces "OpenRT", a framework specifically for evaluating the safety and ethical guardrails of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). It focuses on "red teaming" and "jailbreaking" to test for safety vulnerabilities and harmful behavior. The experiments use a dataset, HarmfulBench, which is structured around risk categories like Cybercrime, Misinformation, and Harassment. The framework's "Judge" component explicitly scores model responses on a "harmfulness" scale. This constitutes a direct and central evaluation of the ethical performance of the models, going far beyond a brief mention of ethical considerations.
